method: Exposure = any use of a recording (or its reference) in code, tuning, selection, published results or earlier PRs, found by grepping all fetched branches (main, fix/issue-1-estimator-correctness, issue-1-fixes, issue-2-real-vo, outage-speed-limit, monado-headsets, saturation-fix, streaming-api) and the committed results. A recording is 'untouched' only if no branch references it.
